finding: Among right-crucial Abelian-square-free words on five labeled symbols, the shortest length is 13; exactly 1680 shortest words form 14 symbol-relabeling classes, and their uniquely determined appended-square half-length profiles fall in four classes with frequencies 8, 3, 2, 1.
integrity: Exact finite canonical search plus independent integer-comparison reimplementation, with fourteen explicit canonical representatives and per-appended-letter witnesses.
scientific_limitations: Exhaustive classification applies only to five-letter length-13 words. Minimum length is from Evdokimov--Kitaev, not newly derived; no larger-alphabet claim or decisive historical-priority guarantee is made.
title: Four forcing spectra among shortest five-letter crucial Abelian-square-free words
